meta.title: Workspace Tints
meta.description: Gives each Workspace a quiet, stable tint from one warm-to-cool gradient of whites, painted on its sidebar header and session rows, and washes a finished, unread chat green.

title: Workspace tints
description: Each Workspace keeps one tone from a single warm-to-cool gradient of tinted whites. The tone washes its header and draws a thin rail beside its Sessions, so neighbouring Workspaces separate without adding loud colour. The ramp skips green, which is reserved for finished chats.
legendHint: A tone is remembered per folder. A new Workspace takes the tone farthest from the ones in use, so the Workspaces you already know keep their colour.
ungrouped: Sessions outside every Workspace stay neutral.
doneNote: A Session that finished and is still unread tints its whole row green — the same green as its status dot.
hierarchyNote: Workspace names are set as section headings, and their Sessions indent beneath them.
